items.title: Docs Template
items.text: A documentation template using Zensical with support for Python, C++, and C# projects.

items.title: Language Sections
items.text:
• Python -- Python documentation with auto-generated API reference via mkdocstrings
  • C++ -- C++ documentation with auto-generated API reference via MkDoxy/Doxygen
  • C# -- C# documentation with auto-generated API reference via MkDoxy/Doxygen

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Dark/light mode toggle
  • Code syntax highlighting for Python, C++, and C#
  • Tabbed content blocks
  • Auto-generated API documentation
  • Search
  • Navigation tabs

items.title: Getting Started
items.text: See the Getting Started guide for setup instructions.

items.title: Prerequisites
items.text:
• Python 3.12+
  • uv
  • Doxygen (for C++/C# API docs)

items.title: Installation
items.text:
Clone the repository and install dependencies:

git clone https://github.com/WeiTing1991/docs-template.git
cd docs-template
uv sync

items.title: Local Development
items.text:
Start the development server:

uv run zensical serve

The site will be available at http://localhost:8000.

items.title: Build
items.text:
Build the static site:

uv run zensical build

Output goes to the site/ directory.

items.title: Project Structure
items.text:
docs/           # Documentation source files
  python/       # Python docs and API reference
  cpp/          # C++ docs and API reference
  csharp/       # C# docs and API reference
src/            # Example source files for autodoc
  python/       # Python source with docstrings
  cpp/          # C++ source with Doxygen comments
  csharp/       # C# source with XML doc comments
zensical.toml   # Zensical config (primary)
mkdocs.yml      # MkDocs-compatible config (fallback)
pyproject.toml  # Python dependencies managed by uv

items.title: Customization
items.text:
1. Replace files in src/ with your actual source code
  2. Update docs/ with your documentation content
  3. Edit zensical.toml (or mkdocs.yml) to adjust site name, nav, and plugin paths
  4. Delete language sections you don't need

items.title: Calculator
items.text:
A simple calculator class.

Attributes:

Name Type Description history list[float]

List of past calculation results.

Source code in src/python/example.py 
class Calculator:
    """A simple calculator class.

    Attributes:
        history: List of past calculation results.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize the calculator with empty history."""
        self.history: list[float] = []

    def multiply(self, a: float, b: float) -> float:
        """Multiply two numbers and store the result.

        Args:
            a: First number.
            b: Second number.

        Returns:
            The product of a and b.
        """
        result = a * b
        self.history.append(result)
        return result

def multiply(self, a: float, b: float) -> float:
    """Multiply two numbers and store the result.

    Args:
        a: First number.
        b: Second number.

    Returns:
        The product of a and b.
    """
    result = a * b
    self.history.append(result)
    return result
